## Setup
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)   # for percent_format()

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v4")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-cart-tumor")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))
```

## Load data
```{r load-seurat-object}
obj <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "cart_annotated.rds"))
```

## Visualize top markers per lineage by dot plot
```{r visualize-top-markers-dotplot, fig.height=16, fig.width=8}
lineage_markers <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "cart_lineage_markers.csv"))

top10_markers <- lineage_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

# separate dot plot for each cluster, save in one pdf file
pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "cart_dotplot_top_lineage_markers.pdf"), width = 11, height = 6)

for (lineage in unique(top10_markers$cluster)) {
  
  markers <- top10_markers %>%
    filter(cluster == lineage) %>%
    pull(gene)
  
  p <- DotPlot(
    obj,
    features = markers,
    group.by = "cell_type",
    assay = "RNA"
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste("Top Markers for", lineage)) +
    RotatedAxis() +
    theme_Publication() +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```

## Lineage stacked barplot
```{r lineage-stacked-barplot}
meta <- as.data.frame(obj@meta.data)
prop_df <- meta %>%
  dplyr::count(condition, cell_type) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = condition, y = prop, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = DiscretePalette(n = length(unique(prop_df$cell_type)))
  ) +
  labs(fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  xlab("Condition") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format())

ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "cart_stacked_barplot_lineage_proportions.png"), width = 8, height = 5)
```
